transferScenario.method: Maximum one-to-one bipartite matching across all reciprocal-ID, equal-amount, seven-day candidate pairs. Both sides retained.
transferScenario.limitation: Maximum is a possible reconciliation within this candidate set, not a verified transfer total or a global upper bound on all internal transfers. One optimum may not be unique; unmatched transfers may have changed dates/amounts or missing IDs.

findings: Concentration persists across these scenarios; magnitudes depend on grouping and the source population. No fuzzy link is promoted by a sensitivity test.
